name: stretch
description: Replies short by default; click a phrase to expand it in place, and finished tool groups fold to one line

shortWords.title: Short reply length
shortWords.description: The most words a reply should take with every phrase closed

foldTools.title: Fold finished tool groups
foldTools.description: Fold each finished group of tool calls to one line with a link to unfold it

marks.title: Closed stretch marks
marks.description: Marks on a phrase you can open, as a list of bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, dim. Empty keeps the underline; none takes every mark away. Under a highlight, dim moves the text toward the highlight.

highlight.title: Closed stretch highlight
highlight.description: Background of a phrase you can open: a hex colour such as #264f78, in any case, or the word tinted, which highlights each closed stretch in the colour its words take once open, blended 75 percent into the background. Its text turns near black or near white, whichever reads better. Empty, or anything else, for none.
